title: Yellow Smoky Syrian Lamb Stew
description: A smoky and velvety one-pot Syrian dish featuring miniature marshmallows and mushimono-steam, made in a bamboo tray and friendly to ayurvedic-rajasic diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bamboo tray over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb shoulder pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the miniature marshmallows and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Use mushimono-steam to cook the marshmallows until they are puffed and lightly browned.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
